acceptance.evidence: An isolated copy of real canonical sources has no distributions/ or generated marketplace before build; source output paths remain absent after install.
167 catalog definitions and 11 plugin definitions validate; all four catalog bundles match exactly; MCP registry paths resolve inside the installed release.
Canonical recommendation-letter edit and temporary skill addition propagate to installed bundles and a reloaded MCP registry; previous release remains unchanged.
Removing the temporary canonical skill removes its installed source, all four runtime copies, registry row, lockfile entry, and cached MCP result.
A registry generator exiting 73 leaves current, previous, and installed manifest unchanged; retained release validates after the source copy is removed.
